Ben — thanks. Quick execution checklist from Legal Ops:
1) Signatory authority: we need a signed Signatory_Authority_Form for the external signer if the signatory is not the CEO/CFO. Please ask Avery to return that before we complete our countersign (I’ve attached our template).
2) Preferred routing (we recommend):
   - Step 1: External signatory signs first (Avery)
   - Step 2: VP Sales (Redwood) signs second — we want business sign-off on commercial terms
   - Step 3: CFO (Redwood) signs third if the deal requires any non-standard financial commitments
   - Step 4: Redwood Legal completes countersign and keeps final executed copy in DocuSign and our contract registry
3) Countersign versus signature stamp: we will countersign (signature block) in DocuSign — no separate PDF stamping step.
4) DocuSign template: use Redwood-Standard-DPA-v4 (template id: RDW-DPA-TPL-204). We can pre-fill our signatory block and routing.

Attachments: Signatory_Authority_Form.pdf

I’ll prepare the envelope once Ben confirms who the external signer will be and provides the signatory email. If Avery insists on signing last, we can flip steps 1/4 but we prefer to receive the initial signed copy.
